background: Intesa Sanpaolo is Italy's largest bank, funded by Italian retail deposits and lending to Italian households and companies, with large wealth management and insurance arms and a smaller international network in Central and Eastern Europe.
synthesis: Ratings are A- from Fitch, BBB+ from S&P on a positive outlook and A3 from Moody's after its upgrade on 25 Nov 2025, grades that sit close to the Italian sovereign's. Capital is mixed against EU and Nordic peers: CET1 of 13.0% is in the bottom quarter against a 16.4% median, while leverage of 5.8% is above the 5.5% median. Liquidity is on the weak side, with LCR of 139% in the bottom quarter and NSFR of 121% below 124%. CET1 has fallen 0.6 points since 30 Jun 2024. The flagged news is all good, with rating upgrades on 11 Sep 2026.
